title: Prospect Pipeline: the work behind the bridge
head: 7d650ea8cd36052faf45c9ca8b8743aa77a4d876
decision: Ask Turing to assess the AI-assisted integration archive: legacy forms, JSON translation, verified changes, and the work records linked to them.
commercial_hypothesis: The record of teaching AI and software to operate a custom legacy system may support training tasks or tests for business AI. Buyer demand for this archive is unconfirmed.

claim_scope.owned_source_reviewed: Raycast/TypeScript and Python/FastAPI integration layer, schemas, tests, and records

claim_scope.not_claimed: Fifteen years of preserved operating data, ownership of the remote backend, or a training-ready dataset.

evidence.meaning: Saved Codex implementation brief with ten rules for the legacy bridge. The brief includes proposed checks; it does not prove every check was enforced.
